subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The merge lane remains the sole classifier of actual proposal risk and keeps its lane/risk-class output byte-for-byte unchanged; impl-review remains the sole projector of that class to the unchanged `skip`, `standard`, or `deep` band vocabulary.
rationale: planned assurance joins existing risk; it does not relocate or duplicate either predicate
fit_criterion: all pre-amendment merge-lane classification and impl-review class-to-band fixtures are byte-identical; only FR-24 consumes the projected band
